$comment: The specification packet for this repository, generated by this repository. Edit this file, then run: node factory/cli.mjs compile profile.json -o specs --force
name: vibecode-like-a-dev
idea: A deterministic compiler for engineering discipline. A developer who can describe an app in one paragraph, or point at a repository they already have, runs it and gets a specification packet an agent can execute: requirements with acceptance criteria, a computed rigor tier, the gates that define done, and a script that fails CI when the spec and the code stop agreeing. Today those developers paste a prompt into an agent and inherit whatever engineering the model happened to infer, which is why the output rarely survives review, maintenance or a second contributor.
